ayahs.ar: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينࣱ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـࣰٔ ا مَّذۡكُورًا
ayahs.en: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned
ayahs.e2: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning
ayahs.tr: Hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجࣲ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.en: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing
ayahs.e2: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see
ayahs.tr: Innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرࣰ ا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayahs.en: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful
ayahs.e2: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful
ayahs.tr: Innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw wa immaa kafoora

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا وَسَعِيرًا
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire
ayahs.tr: Innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa fireena salaasila wa aghlaalanw wa sa'eeraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسࣲ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—
ayahs.tr: innal abraara yashra boona min kaasin kaana mizaa juhaa kaafooraa

ayahs.ar: عَيۡنࣰ ا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance]
ayahs.e2: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will
ayahs.tr: Aynany yashrabu bihaa 'ibaadul laahi yafajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa

ayahs.ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمࣰ ا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread
ayahs.e2: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror
ayahs.tr: Yoofoona binnazri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa

ayahs.ar: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينࣰ ا وَيَتِيمࣰ ا وَأَسِيرًا
ayahs.en: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive
ayahs.e2: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive
ayahs.tr: Wa yut''imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw wa yatemanw wa aseeraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayahs.en: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude
ayahs.e2: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you
ayahs.tr: Innaamaa nut'imukum li wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw wa laa shukooraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسࣰ ا قَمۡطَرِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful
ayahs.e2: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”
ayahs.tr: Innaa nakhaafu mir Rabbinna Yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa

ayahs.ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةࣰ وَسُرُورࣰ ا
ayahs.en: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
ayahs.e2: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy
ayahs.tr: Fa waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratanw wa surooraa

ayahs.ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةࣰ وَحَرِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments]
ayahs.e2: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk
ayahs.tr: Wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo janatanw wa hareeraa

ayahs.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسࣰ ا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold
ayahs.e2: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold
ayahs.tr: muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa 'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw wa laa zamhareeraa

ayahs.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance
ayahs.e2: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach
ayahs.tr: Wa daaniyatan 'alaihim zilaaluhaa wa zullilat qutoofu haa tazleela

ayahs.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةࣲ مِّن فِضَّةࣲ وَأَكۡوَابࣲ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayahs.en: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass]
ayahs.e2: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—
ayahs.tr: Wa yutaafu 'alaihim bi aaniyatim min fiddatinw wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa

ayahs.ar: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةࣲ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure
ayahs.e2: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired
ayahs.tr: Qawaareera min fiddatin qaddaroohaa taqdeeraa

ayahs.ar: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayahs.en: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
ayahs.e2: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger
ayahs.tr: Wa yusawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa

ayahs.ar: عَيۡنࣰ ا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel
ayahs.e2: from a spring there, called Salsabîl
ayahs.tr: Aynan feeha tusammaa salsabeelaa

ayahs.ar: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنࣱ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣰ ا مَّنثُورࣰ ا
ayahs.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls
ayahs.e2: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls
ayahs.tr: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu 'am mansoora

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمࣰ ا وَمُلۡكࣰ ا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.en: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion
ayahs.e2: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa ra ayta summa ra ayta na'eemanw wa mulkan kabeera

ayahs.ar: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرࣱ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣱۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةࣲ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابࣰ ا طَهُورًا
ayahs.en: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink
ayahs.e2: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink
ayahs.tr: Aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw wa istabraq, wa hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw wa saqaahum Rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا
ayahs.en: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated
ayahs.e2: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”
ayahs.tr: Innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz 'anw wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively
ayahs.e2: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages
ayahs.tr: Innaa nahnu nazzalnaa 'alaikal quraana tanzeelaa

ayahs.ar: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورࣰ ا
ayahs.en: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever]
ayahs.e2: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them
ayahs.tr: Fasbir lihukmi Rabbika wa laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
ayahs.e2: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening
ayahs.tr: Wazkuris ma Rabbika bukratanw wa aseelaa

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلࣰ ا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.en: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night
ayahs.e2: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night
ayahs.tr: Wa minal laili fasjud lahoo wa sabbihhu lailan taweelaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا ثَقِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day
ayahs.e2: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them
ayahs.tr: Inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata wa yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa

ayahs.ar: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا
ayahs.en: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration
ayahs.e2: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others
ayahs.tr: Nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaaa asrahum wa izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala hum tabdeelaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way
ayahs.e2: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
ayahs.tr: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise
ayahs.e2: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
ayahs.tr: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaa anyyashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana'Aleeman Hakeema

ayahs.ar: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا
ayahs.en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment
ayahs.e2: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
ayahs.tr: Yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa
